name: smart-shopper-marketplace
description: Self-hosted marketplace for the smart-shopper plugin: a browser-based shopping copilot for Claude Code.

plugins.name: smart-shopper
plugins.description: Browser-based shopping copilot: learns your region once, discovers where people actually buy a category when you don't name a site, confirms a platform shortlist with you, researches it in parallel, hunts coupons, learns your platform/payment don'ts from behavior, and prepares checkout after you pick — never placing an order.
